title: Marguerite and the Glasshouse
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Wendell Dunmore, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
